model.notes: The book is almost entirely short pump-fades. Losses cluster in three cases: high leverage (close floor), momentum that has not yet rolled over at entry, and short crowding that built into a live up-move. These rules are built from those mechanisms and avoid single-name thresholds where possible. Rules 4 and 5 overlap with rule 1, but they cover the leverage dimension separately in case it alone carries the effect.
